description: Welcome home ! This apartment is located on 9th floor and offers an amazing view of Paris. The flat is very modern, cosy, quite, and sunny. It is 24 hour guarded and highly secured residential buildinug. Double bed and a single bed in bed room 1, a king size bed in the bed room 2, and 2 single beds in third bed room. Kitchen has a dishwasher, cooking oven, mocrowave, washing machine with drier, coffee machine and a refrigerator.Secured underground parking in the tower.The spaceThis appartment was renovated recently. Decorated with high quality lights and furnitures. It has an amazing Paris view (Eiffel Tower, Invalid etc..) from three rooms of the appartment.Guest accessComplete appartment is for rent.Digital code is provided with 24 x 24 access.Other things to noteThis place is 500 meters away from Grande Arche monument. Rugby and concert stadium (Arena) very nearby. It has a number of restaurants. It has one of the biggest cinema hall.Metro, Tram and fast train (RER) station is 7 minutes walk.
